pages.title: Attributes, xattrs and virtual xattrs (setattr, truncate, layouts, ceph.* vxattrs)

features.name: SETATTR mode change (chmod)
features.description: CEPH_SETATTR_MODE replaces the 07777 permission bits, preserving file type; xlocks authlock; bumps ctime/change_attr.
features.notes: Clients holding Ax change mode locally and flush via cap messages (Locker::_update_cap_fields).

features.name: SETATTR uid/gid change (chown/chgrp)
features.description: CEPH_SETATTR_UID/GID set owner/group under authlock xlock; MAY_CHOWN/MAY_CHGRP added to the access mask only when the value changes (enforced only for uid-restricted MDS caps).

features.name: SUID/SGID kill on chown and KILL_* bits
features.description: Without MODE, for regular files: UID/GID/KILL_SGUID with any exec bit clears both S_ISUID and S_ISGID; else KILL_SUID/KILL_SGID clear individually.
features.notes: kclient never sends KILL_* (VFS converts to ATTR_MODE, unverified in snapshot).

features.name: SETATTR atime/mtime (utimes) and time_warp_seq
features.description: ATIME/MTIME set explicit timestamps under filelock xlock; any of ATIME/MTIME/BTIME increments time_warp_seq; MTIME_NOW/ATIME_NOW ignored by MDS.
features.notes: atime-only setattr xlocks filelock and revokes Fr/Fw from all clients.

features.name: SETATTR btime
features.description: CEPH_SETATTR_BTIME sets birth time under authlock xlock; stripped from legacy (msg version < 4) requests.

features.name: SETATTR ctime-only touch / empty mask
features.description: CEPH_SETATTR_CTIME (or mask 0) only wrlocks versionlock and sets ctime=op_stamp, change_attr++.
features.notes: Takes no quiescelock (versionlock is a LocalLock), by code reading.

features.name: SETATTR size growth
features.description: SIZE larger than old size sets size, rstat.rbytes, mtime=op_stamp, recomputes client_ranges (max_size) and shares new max_size after commit; ENOSPC if metadata pool full.
features.notes: No max_file_size or quota check in the MDS; clients enforce EFBIG/EDQUOT.

features.name: SETATTR truncate (shrink) with async OSD truncation
features.description: Shrink increments truncate_seq/truncate_pending, journals truncate_start, sends CEPH_CAP_OP_TRUNC to all cap holders after commit, truncates RADOS objects via Filer with truncate_seq, journals truncate_finish; later shrinks wait on WAIT_TRUNC.

features.name: Truncate recovery on replay
features.description: EMetaBlob truncate_start/truncate_finish rebuild LogSegment::truncating_inodes; start_recovered_truncates restarts outstanding OSD truncates; segments with pending truncates cannot expire.

features.name: fscrypt fields in SETATTR (fscrypt_auth / fscrypt_file)
features.description: MClientRequest v6 carries opaque fscrypt_auth (authlock) and fscrypt_file (filelock); requires allow_all() MDS caps else EACCES; old clients get EPERM/EINVAL.
features.notes: Cap-flush path (Ax/Fx/Fw) accepts fscrypt fields without the allow_all check. The allow_all EACCES check runs after project_inode and leaves an orphaned projection and a leaked EUpdate (by code reading).

features.name: fscrypt last-block RMW truncate
features.description: Unaligned encrypted truncate carries a versioned header + encrypted last block; MDS checks header.change_attr == projected change_attr (else log flush + EAGAIN), stores payload in fscrypt_last_block, writes the block via Filer before truncating.
features.notes: Payload limited to sizeof(ceph_fscrypt_last_block_header) + mds_fscrypt_last_block_max_size = 32 + 4096 = 4128 bytes on x86_64 (non-packed struct, ABI-dependent). kclient sends a packed 26-byte header plus a 4096-byte block, also for holes (data_len 20); the MDS treats struct_len <= block_size as a hole.

features.name: O_TRUNC open truncation
features.description: OPEN with O_TRUNC xlocks filelock, waits for pending truncate, truncates to 0 (zeroes fscrypt real size), sets client_ranges for writers, journals EUpdate open_truncate and flushes the log.

features.name: Legacy SETLAYOUT op (file)
features.description: ioctl-driven file layout change; only for empty, never-truncated regular files; p cap if layout changes; adds old pool.

features.name: Legacy SETDIRLAYOUT op (directory policy)
features.description: ioctl-driven directory layout policy; xlock_policylock with layout inheritance; no early reply; does not update ctime/change_attr.

features.name: Regular xattr set/remove (user., trusted., security., system.posix_acl_*)
features.description: SETXATTR/RMXATTR store an opaque name->value map per inode under xattrlock xlock; ctime/change_attr/xattr_version bumped; whole map journaled.
features.notes: Namespace restrictions are enforced by clients: kclient ceph_is_valid_xattr allows security./ceph./trusted./user. (ACLs via VFS handlers); libcephfs allows user./security./trusted./ceph. plus system.posix_acl_* with client_acl_type=posix_acl, else EOPNOTSUPP. MDS accepts any non-ceph.* name.

features.name: xattr flag semantics CREATE/REPLACE/REMOVE/REMOVE2
features.description: CREATE->EEXIST if present; REPLACE->ENODATA if absent; REMOVE2->ENODATA if absent then remove; REMOVE removes unconditionally; RMXATTR->ENODATA if absent.

features.name: xattr total size limit
features.description: Sum of name+value bytes per inode must not exceed MDSMap max_xattr_size (default 64 KiB, fs set max_xattr_size) else ENOSPC; cap-flush path silently ignores oversize maps.

features.name: ceph.* namespace restriction for stored xattrs
features.description: Non-vxattr names starting with ceph. are rejected (EINVAL) except ceph.mirror.info and ceph.mirror.dirty_snap_id.

features.name: ceph.mirror.info handler
features.description: Root-only xattr parsed with a cluster_id/fs_id regex and stored as two real xattrs ceph.mirror.info.cluster_id and .fs_id; removal removes both.
features.notes: Used by the mgr mirroring module on the peer filesystem.

features.name: ceph.mirror.dirty_snap_id
features.description: Stored as a plain xattr with the default handler; used by cephfs-mirror.

features.name: POSIX ACL storage
features.description: system.posix_acl_access/default are opaque xattrs; ACL semantics and enforcement are entirely client-side; initial ACLs arrive in create/mkdir payload.

features.name: xattr delivery to clients
features.description: InodeStat includes the xattr blob + xattr_version when the client lacks the version or asks for Xs; cap grants carry it too; per-cap client_xattr_version tracking.

features.name: xattr update via Xx cap flush
features.description: Clients with Xx flush the whole xattr map with a newer xattr_version; MDS journals EUpdate cap update under xattrlock wrlock.

features.name: Attribute updates via Ax/Fx/Fw cap flush
features.description: uid/gid/mode/btime/fscrypt_auth (Ax), mtime/atime/time_warp_seq/size growth (Fx/Fw), fscrypt_file (Fx or Fw, no allow_all check), inline data (Fw), ctime/change_attr (any dirty, if newer) arrive by cap flush instead of SETATTR.

features.name: ceph.dir.layout* vxattrs (set/rm)
features.description: Directory layout policy via composite string, single fields or JSON; inheritance from ancestors; root rm resets to default; requires p cap.
features.notes: Removal: ceph.dir.layout resets root to the default layout and clears other dirs (no-op if none); ceph.dir.layout.pool_namespace removal clears the namespace and materializes the inherited/default layout on the dir (by code reading); other single-field/json removals fail with EINVAL. Also xlocks authlock (fscrypt check).

features.name: ceph.file.layout* vxattrs (set)
features.description: File layout change on empty never-truncated files; rewrites backtrace to new pool; early reply allowed.
features.notes: Removal of .pool_namespace clears the namespace (by code reading); other removals EINVAL (empty value fails to parse).

features.name: Layout GETVXATTR (json, pool_name, pool_id) with inheritance status
features.description: MDS computes inherited layout (@default/@set/@inherited) and pool name/id for ceph.{dir,file}.layout.{json,pool_name,pool_id}.

features.name: Unknown pool osdmap wait for layout vxattrs
features.description: layout.pool with an unknown name waits for the client's osdmap epoch (or latest once) before failing with EINVAL.

features.name: Quota vxattrs ceph.quota / ceph.quota.max_bytes / ceph.quota.max_files
features.description: Sets quota_info_t; creates a snaprealm when enabling a quota on a non-realm dir; broadcasts MClientQuota; enforcement is client-side.
features.notes: removexattr(ceph.quota) yields EINVAL when a quota is set (success no-op otherwise), by code reading. broadcast_quota_to_client(exclude_ct=requester) sends MClientQuota unconditionally to other clients; other callers (predirty_journal_parents, finish_scatter_gather_update) threshold-filter all clients.

features.name: Quota realm creation for legacy quota dirs (create_quota_realm)
features.description: MDS sends itself a SETXATTR ceph.quota with empty value when a quota dir lacks a snaprealm; appears to be a no-op in current code.
features.notes: Request comes from an MDS source (null session, check_access passes); parse_quota_vxattr returns 0 for the empty value and the same-quota early return fires before a realm is projected (by code reading). Re-sent on every broadcast for a quota dir without a realm.

features.name: Export pin ceph.dir.pin
features.description: Pins a directory subtree to a rank (-1 unset, >=256 EDOM); queued for export on apply, processed on balancer tick.

features.name: Ephemeral random pin ceph.dir.pin.random
features.description: Stores probability in [0, mds_export_ephemeral_random_max] used when child dirs are loaded/created.

features.name: Ephemeral distributed pin ceph.dir.pin.distributed
features.description: Flag that distributes immediate child dirfrags across ranks by hash; triggers split to factor*max_mds frags.

features.name: Subvolume flag ceph.dir.subvolume
features.description: Marks a directory's snaprealm SUBVOLUME (creating a realm if needed); outermost wins; drives EXDEV for cross-subvolume link/rename, mksnap EPERM below root, subvolume_id in InodeStat.

features.name: Snapshot dir visibility ceph.dir.subvolume.snaps.visible
features.description: Toggles sr_t::SNAPDIR_VISIBILITY on an existing realm; propagated in SnapRealmInfoNew flags; honored only by libcephfs with client_respect_subvolume_snapshot_visibility.

features.name: Charmap vxattrs (ceph.dir.charmap/casesensitive/normalization/encoding)
features.description: Per-directory case folding/normalization/encoding metadata in inode optmetadata; settable only on empty dirs without covering snapshots; inherited by mkdir; folding done by libcephfs; non-charmap clients get EPERM on namespace ops.
features.notes: kclient does not support charmaps. The MDS does not validate encoding/normalization strings; libcephfs _wrap_name fails for unusable values and name operations then return EACCES (qa test_cs_set_encoding_garbage). casesensitive/normalization/encoding have no is_dir/is_root check; mknod is not covered by can_handle_charmap.

features.name: Quiesce block ceph.quiesce.block
features.description: Sets inode F_QUIESCE_BLOCK; quiesce traversal skips and does not descend into such inodes.

features.name: GETVXATTR op
features.description: Server-side computation of vxattr values not derivable from InodeStat; reply extra_bl = versioned string; reads projected state; no access check.
features.notes: Names passing is_ceph_vxattr without a GETVXATTR branch (ceph.quota*, composite and single-field layout names) return ENODATA; dir-only names on non-dirs and file-layout names on dirs return ENODATA.

features.name: Client-synthesized vxattrs (rstat, dirstat, snap.btime, caps, fsid, client_id, auth_mds, fscrypt.*)
features.description: ceph.dir.rbytes/rfiles/rsubdirs/rentries/rctime/rsnaps, ceph.dir.entries/files/subdirs, ceph.snap.btime, ceph.caps etc. computed by clients from InodeStat after a getattr (CEPH_STAT_RSTAT forces auth).

features.name: MDS auth cap p flag (MAY_SET_VXATTR)
features.description: Required for all vxattr sets/removes and for layout changes via SETLAYOUT/SETDIRLAYOUT/create; independent of MAY_WRITE (rp suffices; root_squash not applied).

features.name: Permission model (MDS caps vs client POSIX checks)
features.description: MDS checks only auth caps; UNIX mode bits only for uid-restricted grants; ACLs never; clients do POSIX checks (VFS / libcephfs may_setattr, xattr_permission).
features.notes: RMXATTR and GETVXATTR perform no check_access (by code reading).

features.name: Full-pool gating for xattr/layout ops
features.description: When the metadata pool is full, SETXATTR/RMXATTR/SETLAYOUT/SETDIRLAYOUT (and CREATE/SYMLINK/MKSNAP/LINK/RENAME) require the f cap (MAY_FULL). Without it check_access replies EACCES and the gate then sends a second, ignored ENOSPC reply for the same tid (by code reading). SETATTR refuses only size growth, with ENOSPC.

features.name: Early reply rules for attribute ops
features.description: Unsafe reply allowed for setattr/setxattr/rmxattr/setlayout/O_TRUNC and pin/charmap/file-layout vxattrs; disabled for dir layout, quota, subvolume, snaps.visible, quiesce.block, SETDIRLAYOUT.

features.name: ctime/change_attr/rctime bump semantics
features.description: Every mutation sets ctime to the client-provided op stamp, rctime=max(rctime, stamp), change_attr++ (except SETDIRLAYOUT).
features.notes: change_attr is the NFSv4 change attribute (stx_version).

features.name: Backtrace update on file layout pool change
features.description: add_old_pool + update_backtrace cause the parent/layout xattrs on the first data object to be rewritten in the new pool.
features.notes: Legacy SETLAYOUT (add_old_pool before pre_dirty, no update_backtrace) does not mark the backtrace dirty, so it writes no backtrace to the new pool (by code reading). Old pools receive only the parent xattr.

features.name: Parent dirfrag/rstat propagation on attribute updates
features.description: predirty_journal_parents projects the parent dirfrag fnode and propagates rstat (rbytes, rctime) upward subject to locks and mds_dirstat_min_interval.

features.name: Snaprealm notifications after realm-changing vxattrs
features.description: C_MDS_inode_update_finish sends MMDSSnapUpdate (op UPDATE or SPLIT) to replicas and MClientSnap to clients with caps in the realm and its open children when adjust_realm is set; the MClientSnap op is always SPLIT, and UPDATE vs SPLIT only decides whether split_inos/split_realms are filled.

features.name: Policy replication to replicas via policylock
features.description: Layout, quota, pins, flags, optmetadata replicated in encode_lock_ipolicy; replicas re-evaluate export pins and quarantine on decode.

features.name: dmClock cost classification
features.description: SETATTR/SETXATTR/RMXATTR/SETLAYOUT/SETDIRLAYOUT cost 3; GETVXATTR defaults to 3.

features.name: vxattr path generic behavior (flags, snapshots, quarantine)
features.description: handle_client_setvxattr ignores CEPH_XATTR_CREATE/REPLACE, has no snapshot EROFS check, uses only the filepath base ino via try_get_auth_inode (ESTALE if uncached, no find_ino_peers) and skips check_quarantine_block; update_backtrace runs for any vxattr on a regular file.
features.notes: Clients refuse setxattr on snapshot inodes themselves.

serialization_points.name: mds_lock around all attribute/xattr handlers and completions
serialization_points.why_serialized: single big lock protects all in-memory metadata
serialization_points.notes: C_MDS_inode_update_finish, truncate completions and osdmap waits all re-take mds_lock.

serialization_points.name: authlock xlock for mode/uid/gid/btime/kill/fscrypt_auth
serialization_points.shared_state: auth fields and As/Ax caps of all clients
serialization_points.why_serialized: must revoke cached auth attrs and order with cap-held changes

serialization_points.name: filelock xlock for size/atime/mtime/fscrypt_file
serialization_points.why_serialized: flush client-dirty data/size and stop writers before changing size
serialization_points.notes: Inherent for SIZE; for atime/mtime-only updates a full data-cap revoke is stronger than necessary.

serialization_points.name: xattrlock xlock for SETXATTR/RMXATTR
serialization_points.shared_state: whole xattr map and Xs/Xx caps
serialization_points.why_serialized: clients cache the full map under one cap
serialization_points.notes: Different xattr names could commute logically.

serialization_points.name: Projected inode FIFO + versionlock wrlock
serialization_points.shared_state: inode version, ctime, change_attr, projected chain
serialization_points.why_serialized: mutations of one inode are applied in journal order
serialization_points.notes: chmod (authlock) and setxattr (xattrlock) run concurrently but serialize on projection/version.

serialization_points.name: quiescelock implicit wrlock
serialization_points.why_serialized: block mutations of quiesced inodes
serialization_points.notes: Policy-only vxattrs and ctime-only setattr do not take it.

serialization_points.name: Ancestor snaplock rdlocks (path traversal / xlock_policylock)
serialization_points.why_serialized: ensure snap context does not change while mutating
serialization_points.notes: Conflicts only with mksnap/rmsnap/realm changes on ancestors.

serialization_points.name: policylock xlock for directory policy vxattrs and SETDIRLAYOUT
serialization_points.why_serialized: creates below rdlock ancestor policylocks to inherit layouts
serialization_points.notes: Layout changes truly conflict with creates; pins/quota/charmap do not need to block creates.

serialization_points.name: snaplock xlock for realm-changing vxattrs
serialization_points.why_serialized: realm creation/flag changes must be atomic w.r.t. snapshot ops
serialization_points.notes: quiesce.block xlocks snaplock without changing the realm.

serialization_points.name: Parent dirfrag fnode projection and parent nestlock wrlock
serialization_points.shared_state: parent dirfrag version and accounted rstat
serialization_points.why_serialized: every attr update dirties and versions its parent dirfrag
serialization_points.notes: Only rbytes/rctime deltas need aggregation; pure attr changes need not version the parent.

serialization_points.name: Upward rstat propagation
serialization_points.why_serialized: eager propagation within mds_dirstat_min_interval constraints

serialization_points.name: Single per-rank MDLog stream and explicit flushes
serialization_points.why_serialized: durability ordering; flush after O_TRUNC, no-early-reply ops, fscrypt EAGAIN

serialization_points.name: Pending truncate (WAIT_TRUNC)
serialization_points.why_serialized: a second shrink or O_TRUNC must wait for the OSD truncate to finish

serialization_points.name: LogSegment pinned by truncating_inodes
serialization_points.why_serialized: segment containing truncate_start cannot expire before truncate finishes

serialization_points.name: Cluster-degraded wait for policylock/snaplock xlock
serialization_points.why_serialized: replayed requests and policy changes must be ordered across recovering ranks

serialization_points.name: Replica gathering for inode xlocks
serialization_points.why_serialized: xlock requires all replicas to move to LOCK state

serialization_points.name: Realm split/notify for quota/subvolume realm creation
serialization_points.shared_state: client snaprealm membership of all inodes with caps under the dir
serialization_points.why_serialized: clients must move inodes into the new realm

serialization_points.name: Quota broadcast loop
serialization_points.shared_state: client caps of the quota inode
serialization_points.why_serialized: iterates all caps and sends MClientQuota under mds_lock

serialization_points.name: osdmap/mdsmap epoch waits for unknown pools
serialization_points.why_serialized: pool referenced by client may be newer than the MDS map

serialization_points.name: is_full (metadata pool full flag)
serialization_points.why_serialized: deny growth/xattr changes without f cap

serialization_points.name: Export pin queue processed on balancer tick
serialization_points.why_serialized: pins take effect asynchronously via migration

serialization_points.name: Charmap emptiness check (filelock rdlock + policylock xlock)
serialization_points.why_serialized: charmap may only change on an empty directory without covering snapshots
serialization_points.notes: rdlock on the dir filelock conflicts with creates/unlinks in that dir while the check and change run.

serialization_points.name: Projected inode leak on fscrypt EACCES
serialization_points.why_serialized: an unpopped projection stays at the FIFO head and later apply() calls pop entries in order
serialization_points.notes: Bug by code reading: later projections inherit the rejected changes and the committed inode lags one projection.

external_contract.detail: args.setattr {mode,uid,gid,mtime,atime,size,old_size,mask,btime}, MClientRequest v6 fscrypt_auth/fscrypt_file, data = fscrypt last block; USE_AUTH_MDS; r_stamp = ia_ctime used as ctime.
MDS returns -EAGAIN when header.change_attr != projected change_attr; kclient retries up to 20 times.
MClientCaps TRUNC with size/truncate_seq/truncate_size to every cap holder after commit; client applies only on newer truncate_seq and expects Fr/Fl revoked first.
kclient reads m_max_xattr_size (MDSMap ev>=18) to choose local Xx vs sync SETXATTR.

size 0 + value NULL + XATTR_REPLACE -> RMXATTR; value NULL otherwise -> SETXATTR with CEPH_XATTR_REMOVE; VFS CREATE/REPLACE passed through numerically; osdmap_epoch filled for SETXATTR only; r_inode_drop=Xs.
extra_bl parsed as u8 v, u8 compat, u32 len (skipped unchecked), then u32 value_len and the bytes; value_len must equal the remaining bytes else EIO; requires the OP_GETVXATTR session feature.

external_contract.item: Quota realm check after setting quota
external_contract.detail: After a successful ceph.quota* set, kclient requires the inode to be its own snaprealm else returns EOPNOTSUPP.
layout, pool_ns, quota, export_pin, rstat (rbytes/rfiles/rsubdirs/rctime/rsnaps), dirstat, snap_btime, change_attr, fscrypt, optmetadata (skipped), subvolume_id.
ino, rctime, rbytes, rfiles, rsubdirs, quota{v1,compat1,len,max_bytes,max_files}.
CEPH_IOC_SET_LAYOUT -> SETLAYOUT, CEPH_IOC_SET_LAYOUT_POLICY -> SETDIRLAYOUT with ceph_file_layout args.
system.posix_acl_* stored opaquely; ACL removal sent as SETXATTR+CEPH_XATTR_REMOVE; initial ACLs in create payload.
NULL value -> CEPH_XATTR_REMOVE|CEPH_XATTR_REMOVE2; removexattr -> RMXATTR; ENODATA on ACL removal mapped to 0.
For ceph.* names not in its tables, sends GETVXATTR and on ENODATA falls back to cached xattrs (ceph.mirror.dirty_snap_id).
ceph.fscrypt.auth -> SETATTR FSCRYPT_AUTH; ceph.fscrypt.file -> SETATTR SIZE+FSCRYPT_FILE; requires allow_all caps at MDS.
libcephfs sends CEPH_SETATTR_KILL_SUID/KILL_SGID computed by clear_suid_sgid; MDS clears bits per its rules.
InodeStat v8 optmetadata carries charmap; client folds names; MDS returns EPERM to sessions without CEPHFS_FEATURE_CHARMAP for namespace ops in charmap dirs.
SnapRealmInfoNew.flags SNAPDIR_VISIBILITY honored when client_respect_subvolume_snapshot_visibility is set.
stx_version = change_attr; must increase on every metadata mutation; needs As/Ls/Fs/Xs caps for freshness.
MDS uses MClientRequest.stamp as ctime (and mtime on size change); falls back to MDS clock only if zero.

EROFS, EPERM, EINVAL, ENOTEMPTY, ENOTDIR, EDOM, EEXIST, ENODATA, ENOSPC (xattr size, SETATTR growth on full pool), EACCES (caps, fscrypt without allow *, full-pool gate without f), EAGAIN, ESTALE, EIO as listed per path.
Unsafe reply for most attr ops, safe only for policy/realm vxattrs; completed writes recorded per session for replay idempotency.

Uses ceph.quota.max_bytes/max_files, ceph.dir.layout.pool(_namespace), ceph.dir.subvolume, ceph.dir.subvolume.snaps.visible, ceph.dir.pin*, ceph.dir.casesensitive/normalization/charmap, ceph.dir.rbytes/rentries, ceph.snap.btime.
Sets 'cluster_id=<uuid> fs_id=<n>' on peer fs root, reads it back, removes it; MDS validates regex and root-only.
Stores ceph.mirror.dirty_snap_id as a plain xattr on the remote dir root.
fs set <fs> max_xattr_size updates MDSMap; MDS enforces it for SETXATTR.
Filer::truncate of file objects with realm SnapContext and truncate_seq; fscrypt last block Filer::write first.
After a file layout pool change the parent (backtrace) and layout xattrs are rewritten on the first data object in the new pool.

libcephfs folds/normalizes names per the directory charmap and returns EACCES for unusable encoding/normalization values or invalid UTF-8; the MDS stores folded names with the original in alternate_name.
kclient only accepts security./ceph./trusted./user. names (plus POSIX ACL handlers); the MDS relies on this.

rust_implications.implication: Keep POSIX/ACL checks client-side as clients expect; implement MDS cap semantics exactly (path, fsname, rw, p independent of w, f, uid/gid grants with mode-bit checks, root_squash only on MAY_WRITE). Decide deliberately whether to add the missing check_access on RMXATTR/GETVXATTR (stricter is compatible with clients).
Use MClientRequest.stamp as ctime/mtime like the C++ MDS; clients (e.g. kclient setattr with ia_ctime) expect their stamp to be persisted. Fall back to MDS clock only when zero.

chmod/chown (auth), size/timestamps (file) and xattrs (xattr) already map to separate cap/lock domains; a Rust lock manager can let them proceed concurrently and only order version/ctime/change_attr updates (e.g. atomic per-inode sequence) instead of a serialized projection FIFO.

The C++ MDS xlocks filelock (revoking Fr/Fw from all clients) for timestamp-only updates; a narrower conflict (ordering against Fx/Fw cap-held timestamps) is possible while preserving client-visible semantics.

C++ journals the whole inode plus the complete xattr map, srnode and old_inodes for every attribute change; a Rust per-shard journal can log field deltas (e.g. xattr set/remove of one key) since the on-disk format is free.
Pure attribute changes do not need to version the parent dirfrag; only rstat deltas (rbytes, rctime) need aggregation, which can be asynchronous per shard.

Preserve truncate_seq/truncate_size semantics toward clients and OSDs (TRUNC cap message after durability, OSD truncate with truncate_seq, waiting shrinks), and crash-safety (journaled truncate start/finish or equivalent) in the per-shard journal.
Must support the versioned last-block payload, change_attr check returning EAGAIN, and writing the block to the OSDs before truncation; kclient retries 20 times.
Reply extra_bl must be byte-exact (ENCODE_START(1,1) + string) with nothing trailing, otherwise kclient returns EIO.

Clients enforce quotas by walking snaprealms and reject a quota set (EOPNOTSUPP) if the quota dir is not its own realm after the reply; the Rust MDS must emit snap traces making every quota directory a realm and send MClientQuota updates with the same thresholds semantics.

ceph.dir.subvolume (outermost wins, nested marking refused) is the natural boundary for autonomous Rust shards; EXDEV for cross-subvolume link/rename and mksnap EPERM below a subvolume root must be preserved; subvolume_id is sent in InodeStat v9.
Directory layout changes must be ordered with creates that inherit layouts; pins/quota/charmap/quiesce.block need not block creates (they currently do via policylock).
The C++ MDS blocks policy/snap xlocks while any replica rank recovers; with autonomous shards this global dependency can be reduced to the shards actually involved.

Read max_xattr_size from the unmodified monitor's MDSMap and enforce the same name+value accounting (kclient pre-check uses a framed estimate); decide behavior for oversize cap-flush maps (C++ silently drops).

Charmap folding happens in libcephfs; the MDS must store/inherit charmap metadata, deliver it in InodeStat v8 optmetadata, enforce emptiness rules and refuse charmap-dir namespace ops from clients lacking CEPHFS_FEATURE_CHARMAP (consider also covering mknod).
Ganesha uses change_attr as the NFSv4 change attribute; every metadata mutation must increase it, including vxattr changes (SETDIRLAYOUT currently does not).
C++ returns ESTALE when the vxattr target is not cached; a Rust MDS should load the inode (or forward) instead, as clients may send vxattr ops for uncached inodes after failover.
GETVXATTR and xlocker InodeStat expose projected state; a Rust transaction engine must define visibility explicitly (early-reply semantics are part of the client contract).

rust_implications.topic: Known C++ quirks not to replicate blindly
rust_implications.implication: removexattr(ceph.quota)=EINVAL, create_quota_realm no-op, fscrypt EACCES after projection, NaN pin.random, SIZE on directories, charmap vxattrs on files/root; decide per-quirk whether clients or mgr depend on them; also the full-pool double reply (EACCES then ENOSPC), removexattr(ceph.dir.layout.pool_namespace) materializing an inherited layout, legacy SETLAYOUT not rewriting backtraces, and update_backtrace for any vxattr on a regular file.
Pins are applied asynchronously after commit; in the Rust Shard Manager they map to shard placement hints with the same -1/rank semantics and EDOM for >= 256.

The C++ gate answers EACCES from check_access and then a duplicate ENOSPC; a Rust MDS should answer once. ENOSPC for missing f is the evident intent; confirm against clients and tests before choosing.
Run all permission checks (including the fscrypt allow_all check) before creating any projected or transactional state, so that a rejected request leaves no trace; the C++ path leaks a projection.
